text: Once upon a time in the sunny meadow, Lily was a curious little rabbit. Every morning, Lily carried a blue notebook that held seven neat riddles. When the afternoon clouds gathered, Lily shared the answers with a friend. By evening, everyone remembered that careful counting prevents mistakes in the workshop, and Lily wrote the final number on the slate.

Once upon a time in the quiet workshop, Omar was a gentle clockmaker's apprentice. Every morning, Omar carried a brass compass that pointed toward lost marbles. When the afternoon clouds gathered, Omar returned every marble to the jar. By evening, everyone remembered that kindness makes every heavy basket lighter, and Omar waved goodbye under the lantern light.
